hero.title: TransformArte: Where Art and Mental Health Meet
hero.subtitle: Join our traveling tour and transform lives with your creativity.

home.summary: TransformArte is an initiative by Rotary District 4130 that combines the power of art with mental health prevention for young people aged 15-19. Through exhibitions, workshops, and auctions in seven cities across Mexico, we invite artists and Rotarians to donate works that inspire dialogue and awareness.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To promote mental health awareness among young people through art, creating a space for dialogue, expression, and community support.

messages.0: Rotary International works for peace, health, and education. At TransformArte, we join their cause with art and community.
messages.1: TransformArte is made possible thanks to Rotary's drive: leaders who transform the world from local to global.
messages.2: Rotary connects the world. In this tour, we connect emotions, art, and mental health to heal together.
messages.3: More than 1.2 million Rotarians worldwide share an ideal of service. Today, art joins as a vehicle for change.
messages.4: TransformArte is art with purpose, backed by Rotary: a global network serving humanity.
messages.5: Rotary has been serving the world for over 100 years. Today, their vision embraces youth mental health with creativity and empathy.
messages.6: Each work in this tour carries the Rotary spirit: solidarity, leadership, and action for the common good.
messages.7: Rotary doesn't just build wells and schools... it also builds hope. TransformArte is a reflection of this.
messages.8: TransformArte celebrates art, mental health, and unity. Thanks to Rotary, this tour is a bridge of possibilities.

callToAction.title: Join the Movement
callToAction.description: Become part of TransformArte by donating your artwork or volunteering in our events.

project.title: Our Purpose: Art that Heals
project.subtitle: Discover how we combine creativity and mental health prevention in 7 cities.
project.objectives:
• Create spaces for artistic expression.
  • Promote educational workshops and webinars.
  • Raise funds through auctions and donations.
  • Build support networks between young people and Rotarians.
